purpose: pre-proposal feasibility evidence; not final thesis performance claims
short_diagnostics: 64-request serial pressure trace: stock at moderate/roomy capacity
workload_controls: three cache budgets on the same hot workload
unique per-request cache salt for no cross-request reuse
p99_role: descriptive only with 512 correlated requests per run
baseline_review: stock-only check of applicable prefix matching/checkpoint settings; record all tried settings before freezing
interpretation: three paired seeds per workload support preliminary consistency only; final representative five-pair target remains in the main protocol
run_time_policy: estimate after GPU calibration; require explicit time budget; retain every failure and partial run
pre_proposal_completion: serial diagnostic output hashes match or discrepancies are explained
native hybrid cache groups and boundary losses characterized
both main workloads have three complete pairs
no-reuse overhead and capacity/concurrency controls recorded
